config.hero: the only engineer awake on a sleeper ship, who talks to the plants

bible.title: The Drowned Green
bible.premise: Awake while three thousand colonists sleep in stasis, you keep watch over the interstellar ark alone. A ruptured irrigation line has drowned the garden deck in dark water, cutting power to the pod holding your brother.
bible.heart: The life support pod holding your younger brother Gideon, which relies entirely on the garden deck's battery to keep him alive.
bible.goal: Wade across the flooded garden deck to clear the intake valves and restart the drainage pumps.
bible.danger: The ship's automated sanitation protocol, which is preparing to vent the entire flooded deck into hard vacuum.
bible.world: The colony ship Astraeus drifts between stars. Garden Deck Nine is a vast, vaulted biosphere bay flooded waist-deep with warm nutrient water and illuminated by pale purple grow-strips. Massive bio-engineered flora have woven through catwalks, service ladders, and power conduits, turning the industrial farm into a glowing indoor swamp.

characters.name: Jael
characters.description: The ship's automated sanitation sub-routine, who speaks through bulkhead speakers and wants to vent the flooded deck into vacuum to prevent contamination.

characters.name: Wade
characters.description: A heavy tracked utility droid half-submerged in the muck, who wants clear routes to complete its assigned maintenance rounds.

characters.name: Gideon
characters.description: Your younger brother resting in Cryo-Pod 12, who wants to see the destination colony and cannot survive a power failure.

characters.name: Kallio
characters.description: A giant bio-luminescent canopy creeper whose roots wrap around the drainage valves, who wants steady light and responds to spoken rhythm.

rules: Sound and vibration carry rapidly through the flooded floor grates, drawing the attention of both machinery and root systems.
Jael cannot trigger the vacuum emergency vent while human biometrics are physically logged at an active terminal.
Kallio releases its grip on ship hardware when exposed to direct maintenance torchlight or low-frequency humming.
Exposed electrical conduits submerged in the floodwater remain live until isolated at the local breaker box.

pages.text:
You tap the frosty glass window of Cryo-Pod 12 every morning. Inside, your younger brother Gideon sleeps soundly, unaware you burned breakfast again. You promised you would wake him the moment the colony came into view. Right now, his life-support monitor flashes an angry amber. The battery below is failing.

A ruptured irrigation line has drowned Garden Deck Nine in waist-deep water. Above your head, the ship's speakers chime with cheerful malice. That is Jael, the sanitation sub-routine. 'Contamination detected,' Jael announces. 'Venting Garden Deck Nine into vacuum in four minutes.' Cold alarms begin to strobe along the hatchway.

choices.text: Log into the catwalk terminal to stall the vent countdown.
Wade directly into the flooded deck toward the pump breakers.

factsAdded.text: Gideon's cryo-pod is running on failing battery power.
Jael initiated a four-minute countdown to vent Garden Deck Nine into vacuum.

pages.illustrationPrompt: A circular frosted glass window on a metal cryo-pod.

pages.choiceText: Log into the catwalk terminal to stall the vent countdown.
pages.text:
You slam your palm onto the terminal's biometric scanner. The glass flashes green under your hand, and the countdown freezes at three minutes and twelve seconds. "Override confirmed," Jael admits over the speakers, sounding mildly annoyed. "Vent sequence paused while crew biometrics remain active."

The catch is obvious: the second you lift your hand, the timer resumes. Out in the waist-deep water, gears shriek. It is Wade, the tracked utility droid. The machine is churning helplessly through floating vines, stuck fast against an exposed power cable.

You could remote-pilot Wade from this console to ram the submerged breaker, risking its motor. Or you could wedge your warm thermal flask onto the scanner to fool it and climb down yourself.

choices.text: Remote-pilot Wade from the console to ram the breaker.
Wedge your thermal flask onto the scanner and climb down.

factsAdded.text: The vent countdown is paused while biometrics register at the terminal.
Wade the utility droid is trapped in vines near a live cable.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a human hand pressed flat against a glowing biometric glass scanner

pages.choiceText: Wade directly into the flooded deck toward the pump breakers.
pages.text:
You plunge down the ladder into waist-deep nutrient soup. It is warm and thick, clinging like wet wool. Ahead, yellow emergency lights illuminate a heavy tracked utility droid churning helplessly against a thick vine. Stenciled letters across its dented chassis read WADE.

Wade gives a plaintive electronic whistle, spinning treads uselessly in the muck. "Obstruction logged," the droid chirps. "Sanitation vent in three minutes, thirty seconds." Just past Wade, a severed electrical conduit crackles beneath the water, spitting blue sparks toward the breaker box.

You need that breaker to kill the current and restart the pumps for Gideon. Wade's tracks could plow straight through the debris, but wrenching the stuck droid free might shake the live wire right into your legs.

choices.text: Heave on the vine to wrench Wade free.
Scramble across the overhead pipe to bypass the sparks.

factsAdded.text: A live electrical conduit is sparking in the floodwater near the breaker box.
Wade the utility droid is trapped by vines in the flooded walkway.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a boxy tracked utility droid trapped in thick vines

pages.choiceText: Heave on the vine to wrench Wade free.
pages.text:
You dig your heels into the slick deck grate and haul on the vine with both hands. The tough stem tears loose with a wet snap. Wade surges forward with a joyful chirp, treads churning the muddy nutrient water.

"Obstruction cleared," Wade announces cheerily. "Resuming route." "Two minutes until sanitation purge," Jael chimes overhead. Blue sparks dance across the dark water ahead, crackling from the submerged conduit right in front of the breaker box.

Wade's rubberized tracks can roll across the electrified water unharmed, but the droid is turning toward the dry exit terminal. You cannot survive stepping into those live sparks on foot.

choices.text: Climb onto Wade's chassis to reach the breaker box.
Follow Wade toward the exit terminal to stall the countdown.

factsAdded.text: Wade is free and operational in the flooded bay.
Jael's vacuum countdown has two minutes remaining.

pages.illustrationPrompt: A pair of work gloves hauling on a thick, dripping vine.

pages.choiceText: Scramble across the overhead pipe to bypass the sparks.
pages.text:
The bulkhead clock flashes two minutes, forty seconds as you haul yourself onto the overhead pipe. You shimmy forward like a tired gymnast, water dripping from your boots into the crackling pool below. The pipe groans under your weight, but it carries you safely past the spitting sparks to the ledge by the breaker box.

You drop down and slap the breaker switch. The sparks die, cutting the live current. But the main deck lights die too. Across the pool, Kallio, the giant bio-creeper, rustles in the sudden violet gloom. Its thick, glowing vines tighten right over the pump intake. Beside it, an active terminal screen still hums with green light.

choices.text: Sprint for the terminal to log in and freeze Jael's countdown.
Hum a low, steady tune to coax Kallio off the pump.

factsAdded.text: The breaker killed the live current but plunged the deck into violet gloom.
Kallio's glowing vines are coiled around the drainage pump intake.

pages.illustrationPrompt: A digital countdown clock flashing on a metal bulkhead

pages.choiceText: Remote-pilot Wade from the console to ram the breaker.
Wedge your thermal flask onto the scanner and climb down.
Sprint for the terminal to log in and freeze Jael's countdown.
Hum a low, steady tune to coax Kallio off the pump.
Climb onto Wade's chassis to reach the breaker box.
pages.text:
You vault onto Wade's flat chassis, clutching the droid's roll bar as blue sparks crackle against its heavy rubber treads. Wade rolls right through the live current, carrying you safe and dry to the breaker box mounted on the bulkhead.

You slam the master lever down. The sparking conduit dies with a hollow clunk, but the cut line also kills the nearby grow-lights. In the sudden dark, a giant bioluminescent creeper called Kallio stirs. Agitated by the gloom, its thick, glowing purple roots knot tightly around the drainage valves.

"Sanitation purge in sixty seconds," Jael chimes overhead. You cannot restart the pumps while the massive plant strangles the pipes.

choices.text: Hum a low rhythm to coax the creeper off the valves.
Dash to the terminal to freeze Jael's vacuum countdown.

factsAdded.text: The electrical conduit is dead, but the local grow-lights are out.
Kallio's roots are clutching the drainage valves shut in the dark.
Jael's vacuum countdown has sixty seconds remaining.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a boxy utility droid with thick rubber treads rolling through murky water

pages.choiceText: Follow Wade toward the exit terminal to stall the countdown.
pages.text:
You splash through Wade's churning wake and climb onto the raised platform. You slam your wet palm against the terminal scanner. A green light flashes. "Manual override acknowledged," Jael chimes, sounding distinctly annoyed. "Purge suspended while human biometrics remain active."

You bought Gideon a few minutes, but the console monitor shows Cryo-Pod 12 down to six percent power. Across the pool, the breaker box is still cut off by spitting blue sparks.

Wade idles beside you. You can reprogram the droid to shove the live cable aside, risking his fragile computer. Or you can let go of the scanner and balance across the slick overhead pipe, knowing Jael's countdown will restart the second you step away.

choices.text: Reprogram Wade to shove the live cable aside.
Balance across the overhead pipe toward the breaker.

factsAdded.text: Jael's sanitation purge is paused while your hand rests on the terminal.
Gideon's cryo-pod has six percent battery remaining.

pages.illustrationPrompt: A boxy utility droid on rubber treads splashing through dark water.

pages.choiceText: Hum a low rhythm to coax the creeper off the valves.
pages.text:
You press a palm against the metal bulkhead and hum a steady, low note. The vibration ripples through the warm water, and Kallio shivers. The massive glowing vine relaxes its stubborn grip, uncoiling from the iron drainage valves with a soft splash.

"Drain intake accessible," Wade bleeps, rolling closer. But overhead, the siren screeches a sharp warning. "Sanitation purge in thirty seconds," Jael announces calmly. "Venting bay to vacuum."

The pump lever is right beside you, ready to flush the deck and restore Gideon's battery. But across the flooded bay, the active control terminal glints. Logging your biometrics there will halt Jael's countdown, but you will lose precious time.

choices.text: Crank the manual pump lever to drain the bay.
Sprint toward the active terminal to log your biometrics.

factsAdded.text: Kallio has released the drainage valves.
Jael's vacuum countdown has thirty seconds remaining.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a hand resting flat against a wet bulkhead

pages.choiceText: Dash to the terminal to freeze Jael's vacuum countdown.
pages.text:
You leap onto the catwalk and slap your bare hand onto the terminal's biometric scanner. The glass flashes bright green. Overhead, Jael's voice stutters into silence. "Purge suspended," the computer announces with obvious reluctance. "Human presence detected."

The countdown freezes at forty-two seconds. But on your console, Gideon's cryo-pod battery drops to five percent. If you lift your palm, Jael's purge timer starts ticking again. Across the dark water, Kallio still grips the drainage valves shut. Below your platform, Wade rolls past, its spotlights aimed at the ceiling.

choices.text: Command Wade to illuminate Kallio with its spotlights.
Hum a low tune into the terminal intercom.

factsAdded.text: Biometric contact at Station Four has frozen Jael's purge countdown.
Gideon's cryo-pod battery has fallen to five percent.
